note: Creatives are typographic concept cards (SVG). Export to PNG at upload. Each carries a visible 'Concept. In development.' label. No app screens are shown. The copy never calls the app AI. Audience is adult and university learners; the platform's own targeting is set to 18 and over.

creatives.primary_text: A study app in development that builds flashcards only from your own notes, in your own words, and shows the source for each card. Early access, nothing is charged today.
creatives.headline: Cards made only from your notes

creatives.primary_text: Every card in this concept links to the passage it came from. Import a text PDF or paste notes. In development. Join the early-access list, nothing is charged today.
